Definition: Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shemiramoth is the name of two Levites: one who sang and played when the ark was brought up, and one whom Jehoshaphat sent to teach in the cities of Judah. The name means the heights of heaven, or the name of the heights.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Shemiramoths show the two works of the Levite: to sing before the ark and to teach in the cities. I hold that worship and teaching belong together.
RelatedPeople: Shemiramoth, Singer; Shemiramoth, the Levite; King David
